concept: Redshift: OLAP warehouse for analytics and BI
tests: Choosing a database designed for complex analytical queries over historical data.
expected: Amazon Redshift — columnar MPP warehouse for OLAP. Triggers: "complex analytical queries", "aggregations", "years of historical data", "BI dashboards".
why_not: DynamoDB is key-value without analytical joins/scans; RDS is row-based OLTP; ElastiCache is an in-memory cache.
